memories.content: Juniper is a rabbit with dental problems and eats timothy hay.
Saffron owns an antique maple loom kept in the workshop.
The saffron spice is stored in a sealed jar in a dark kitchen cupboard.
The Dobsonian telescope needs a red filter for observing Mars.
The island ferry runs on Saturdays but has no Sunday service.
Heirloom tomato seeds are planted beside the window in February.
Brass concerts require earplugs because the trumpet section is loud.
The garden gate has a stiff bolt that needs graphite lubricant.
The blue bicycle has a punctured rear tire and needs a replacement tube.
